_readme: NOMOS-SPEC-008 rev. 0.8.0 vectors: an Act under several laws. Verify each case's act as for vectors.json (root_public_key_pem, relying_party_id, local_facts, currency_policy, in_force); where a case carries evaluate_only, pass it as the artifact ids of the resolved applicable set (rev. 0.8.0 §6.4). Compare every field `expected` names; `laws` is compared as a list, in the order the Act carries its authorities.

cases.name: two_laws_both_allow
cases.note: The lending policy and the data protection law both govern the act; each permits it over the facts it declares, so the Act commits.
